scope: Hippo Bay, existing Zoo Berlin west v165 owners only
temporalQualification: The current operator describes the double-domed Hippo Bay opened in 1997. The requested 'new' hippo house is interpreted as this existing building, distinct from the Nashorn-Pagode opened in 2023. No new 2026 hippo building or completed replacement is established by the inspected primary sources.
geometryLimitation: The retained LoD2 approximates the doubly curved roof with three broad triangulated sheets. Frame bars follow those elevations; no second curved shell conceals, replaces or claims to correct the measured source.

sources.facts: 1997 opening, approximately 1000 m² glass roof, over 800 panes
Architect J. Gribl; 29/21 m spans, 1.20 m mesh, 60×40 mm steel grid beams
sources.photoCredit: SNOWBOUND, via schlaich bergermann partner; reference only

sources.facts: 2016 project account: continuous double-curved glazed net shell and concave visitor hall

estimates: Grid bearing/phase, 60 mm visible strip width, coping width, steel hue and 3 m facade-post spacing are display estimates. 1.20 m published mesh guides the drawn grid but does not establish as-built individual pane positions/count. Native uses independent 3 m rib courses on retained 1 m source cells, flush with their original ceilings.
